verdict.rationale: Notion provides generic REST API, webhooks, and OAuth building blocks (notion-docs-1,3,4) that a third party could use to build a sync, but there is no evidence of an official or documented bi-directional issue-tracker (e.g., GitHub/Jira) sync feature. Community feedback explicitly notes the lack of a GitHub integration as a dealbreaker for tech teams (notion-comm-7), confirming no such capability ships.
